_comment: Maps each Paycheck8 'Jobcode/FY' code to how it should show up on the OF-288. Unrecognized jobcodes cause the tool to stop and ask, rather than guess. Edit this file as new jobcodes show up on future paystubs.

WFSE1226.note: Default/home-unit duty code, not incident time — excluded from the OF-288 entirely.

66.note: PP15 8/4 was coded as admin leave but has real clock times (0900-1700) — looks like it was actually worked EK4Q time miscoded as trans 66, so it's included here and falls through to this jobcode's own group/accounting code rather than being excluded as leave.
